items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got Davey in there by telling the examining doctor, “Look, this guy’s one of the greatest drummers in the world... I got the band together, somehow. We rehearsed it and used my book.

ctx.x: I can’t. I really can’t. I can’t tell you about that. It was the worst experience I’ve ever had in my life. I was in the Navy in a totally anomalous position. Nobody knew what to do with that band. Nobody knew what to do with me. I didn’t know what to do. In effect I had my own little platoon in the Navy, going around, and our orders were as loose as, “Go to Pearl Harbor. Report to Pearl Harbor.” Nobody knew what to do with us. There was nothing like it in the Navy ever before. We were Band 501. Their bands were…
Chief what? Chief petty officer or something?
